title: Gensokyo Reimagined MMORPG
description: Creating A Touhou MMORPG Server in Minecraft.
body:
**Note: The project is still being worked on so for the time being, the ip will redirect you to a publically joinable build server where you can build in the plots and explore the world.**

 
 
### Welcome to Gensokyo Reimagined

Step through the Hakurei Barrier and enter **Gensokyo Reimagined**, an immersive Minecraft MMORPG project that brings the vibrant and mystical world of the *Touhou Project* to life! 

Our server is dedicated to faithfully recreating the land of Gensokyo and transforming it into a fully playable, massively multiplayer role-playing experience. Whether you are a die-hard Touhou fan or an RPG enthusiast looking for a massive new fantasy world to explore, Gensokyo Reimagined offers a unique blend of exploration, custom combat, and community.

**Key Features of the Server:**
* **A Massive Custom World:** Explore iconic, meticulously built locations across Gensokyo, from the peaceful Hakurei Shrine and the bustling Human Village to the imposing Scarlet Devil Mansion.
* **Deep MMORPG Mechanics:** Engage with custom questlines, level up your character's abilities, and grind for unique weapons and artifacts tied to Touhou lore.
* **Epic Boss Battles:** Form parties with other players to test your skills against formidable Youkai and familiar faces from the series in challenging, custom-scripted encounters. 
  * **For example:** <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DkP0ZA5EwV4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

* **Dynamic Community:** Join a growing player base of fans, establish alliances, trade goods in a player-driven economy, and experience the wonders and dangers of Gensokyo together.

The balance of Gensokyo awaits. Are you ready to begin your adventure?
